rationale: Arpan brings 14+ years building fintech and AI-driven systems at scale (Fintegration, SportsFirst), while Junfan is deeply specialized in agentic AI, LLMs, and multi-agent reasoning—exactly the orchestration layer Arpan identifies as the winning approach over greenfield builds. Arpan is explicitly open to discussing new product ideas in FinTech and Blockchain; Junfan's expertise in LangGraph, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflows maps directly to the AI-powered financial systems Arpan sees reshaping payments.
intro_message: Arpan Desai, meet Junfan Zhu — Arpan builds fintech and AI orchestration at scale, and Junfan specializes in agentic AI and LLM frameworks; you two should compare notes on how AI is actually reshaping financial systems.
